general.title: General
app.title: Blue Baton Settings
app.name: Blue Baton
diag.title: Diagnostics
tray.upToDate: Blue Baton is up to date
tray.updateFailed: Couldn't update Blue Baton. Try again later
log.title: Developer: communication log
combo.needModifier: Hold a modifier (Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Cmd) with the key
combo.badKey: That key can't be used in a combo
error.busy: Can't do that right now. Already connected, or another connection attempt is in progress.
error.not_found: Couldn't find that device. Try scanning again.
error.no_slot: Both input device slots (2) are in use. Disconnect one, then try again.
error.inputs_full: Two input devices are paired. Remove one to add another.
error.no_request: There's no pairing request to answer. It already finished or was cancelled.
error.failed: The board couldn't complete the request.
error.timeout: The board isn't responding. Check the USB connection.
error.closed: The connection to the board was lost.
error.send_failed: Couldn't send to the board. Check the USB connection.
error.port_busy: Another program is using the USB port. Close other tabs, serial monitors, and flash tools, then try again.
error.no_serial: This browser doesn't support USB connections (Web Serial). Open this page in Chrome or Edge.
error.bridge_down: The bridge isn't running. Start firmware/tools/bridge.py.
error.bridge_released: The bridge released the port for flashing. It reconnects by itself when done.
error.bridge_no_board: The bridge can't find the board. Check the USB connection.
error.host_window: The host pairing window is open. Close it before adding an input device.
error.hosts_full: All 3 host slots are in use. Remove one, then add again.
error.bad_nick: A host name can be up to 8 characters.
error.app_no_board: Can't find the board. Check the USB cable; Blue Baton connects as soon as it appears.
error.app_port_busy: Another program is using the board's USB port (a serial monitor or the flasher). Close it and Blue Baton reconnects by itself.
error.bad_combo: That switch combo isn't valid. Use modifiers (ctrl, shift, alt, cmd) plus one key.
error.bad_request: The board didn't understand the request.
error.unknown_cmd: The board doesn't know this command. Update the firmware.
fail.not_bonded: The device didn't save the pairing
fail.no_hid_service: This device has no keyboard or mouse function
fail.no_usable_input: This device has no keys, pointer or media keys the board can pass on
reason.remote: The device disconnected (e.g. to save power)
link.releaseTitle: Releases the USB port so other programs can use the board
link.connectHint: Connect the board by USB, then click Connect board (Chrome or Edge).
hosts.title: Hosts
hosts.step: On the computer, connect “{name}” in Bluetooth settings.
hosts.stalled: {name} stopped reconnecting after its link dropped several times (macOS gives up after 5). On that computer, click Connect next to “{board}” in Bluetooth settings. Don't remove it here: that would need a new pairing.
hosts.codeBoard: Or type it on the board's keyboard, then Enter
hosts.passkeyHelp: Enter the code shown on the computer
devices.title: Input devices
devices.full: Up to two devices. Remove one first.
add.title: Add device
add.step1: Put the device in pairing mode.
prompt.numcmp: Check that this matches the number shown on the device
prompt.passkeyDisplay: Type this code on the keyboard, then Enter
notice.bondFull: Pairing storage full ({bonds}/{max}). Remove a device first.
notice.connectFailed: Couldn't connect. Is the device in pairing mode?
notice.hostPairFailed: Host pairing failed. Try again from the computer.
notice.hostBackoff: A computer keeps failing to connect, so the board paused for {seconds} s. If you removed a computer, also remove “{board}” in its Bluetooth settings.
notice.hostSlotsFull: A new computer tried to pair, but all 3 host slots are in use. Remove one first.
notice.hostRepairBlocked: Host {host} is trying to pair again.
confirm.removeHost:
Remove {name}?
Also remove “{board}” in that computer's Bluetooth settings, or it keeps trying to connect.
inputs.title: Input monitor
inputs.hint: Shows the input reaching the board, decoded with its Report Map. The board sends what is typed only while this is open.
inputs.mapWaiting: Waiting for the Report Map (the board reads it and sends it when a device connects)
inputs.fieldsHint: Non-zero fields in the last report
inputs.rawOnly: No Report Map yet, raw data only: {data}
fw.title: Firmware
fw.updateConfirmBody: The board restarts. Pairings are kept.
fw.otherChip: Built for {chip}. The app's firmware is for ESP32-S3 boards, so updates are not offered here
fw.otherTitle: This board doesn't run Blue Baton yet
fw.otherHint: Installs Blue Baton {version}. The board is erased.
fw.installConfirmBody: Everything on the board is erased.
fw.failed: The firmware could not be written: {error}
fw.failedHint: Replug the board and try again. If it still fails, hold BOOT while plugging it in.
fw.chipMismatch: This board's chip is {chip}. The app installs Blue Baton on ESP32-S3 boards only; for other chips, build it yourself (README, Boards).
